clips.title: The story
paras: When the gnomes evacuated their irradiated capital, massive archives of vital technical knowledge and records were left behind. Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge recruits daring operatives to infiltrate Gnomeregan and retrieve a high-security Prismatic Punch Card. Navigating through layers of computerized clearance, couriers must punch their way through progressively fortified terminals deep within the ruined city.

The sudden fall of Gnomeregan to troggs and deadly radiation forced the gnomish populace to abandon centuries of advanced research, schematics, and civic logs. Scattered throughout the technological corridors are Matrix Punchograph terminals, the automated data hubs that regulate security clearances and file storage. For exile leaders like Master Mechanic Castpipe, recovering these punch-encoded archives from the ruined depths represents one of the highest priorities of the refugee community in Tinker Town.

Gnomish data protocol demands rigorous clearance before granting access to central mainframes. Operating the system requires starting with a basic White Punch Card found among the wreckage outside the inner gates. Inserting it into a Matrix Punchograph 3005-A in the Train Depot produces a Yellow card, which must then be carried into the Dormitory's 3005-B terminal for a Blue upgrade, advanced through model 3005-C for a Red card, and finally brought down into the Engineering Labs to encode the coveted Prismatic Punch Card.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When we fled Gnomeregan, we left so much data behind! Vitally important data!

I need the data on a prismatic punch card, from a Matrix Punchograph 3005-D high security terminal, deep in Gnomeregan. You must access the terminal, but to do that you first need clearance... And to get that you must access lower security terminals-- models -A, -B and -C. And to do THAT you need security punch cards, starting with white... And we left all the punch cards in the city.
It's a catastrophe! Can you help?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the prismatic punch card??

clips.title: Completion
paras: You did it! You found the prismatic punch card and recovered the lost data! Vitally, critically, immeasurably important data that we could not live another moment without!
Your service to the gnomes will be long remembered, friend.
